item.title: Saab, Aquark Technologies, and Royal Navy Complete World-First Quantum Timing Radar Trial
item.summary: Saab UK, quantum timing startup Aquark Technologies, and the Royal Navy’s Disruptive Capabilities and Technologies Office (DCTO) have successfully completed a defense field trial integrating cold-atom quantum clocks with operational military radar networks.
